659:t_012:14.en:
$$早乙女$$
(Living together... That is all there is to it.)

659:t_012:17.en:
$$早乙女$$
(It is a simple thing. Understand others, accept them... and then advance into the future together.)

659:t_012:18.en:
$$早乙女$$
(That is the power that lets lives, each small and frail on its own, endure in this dark and endless universe... In other words, the truth of life...)

659:t_012:19.en:
$$早乙女$$
(To give it form, I built a machine that joins three hearts into one... $$ゲッター$$ Robo.)

659:t_012:20.en:
$$コーウェン$$
(I understand...! I understand what $$早乙女$$ is saying!)

659:t_012:21.en:
$$スティンガー$$
(When we were researching the $$ゲッター線$$, we shared our dreams, our futures, and our tomorrows!)

659:t_012:23.en:
$$スティンガー$$
(That is the power to live in the universe!)

659:t_012:25.en:
$$スティンガー$$
(We no longer feel hunger or the urge to destroy...)

659:t_012:28.en:
$$早乙女$$
(Take care, $$元気$$... No, $$渓$$... Don't you lose.)

659:t_013:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「Through the guidance of the $$ゲッター線$$... of Dr. $$早乙女#getter$$... were those two freed from the Great Void, too?」

659:t_014:2.en:
$$渓$$
「Centered on that dimensional rift, the dimensional boundary is warping... No, collapsing!」

659:t_014:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「The Great Void... The force that seeks to vanish...!」

659:t_014:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Is the whole universe going to collapse here!?」

659:t_014:6.en:
$$桂$$
「It's no good! Even if we attempt a $$時空修復|lc$$, we know nothing about the $$超特異点|lc$$!」

659:t_014:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「At this rate, everything in the universe will be consumed by the Great Void...!」

659:t_014:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So all we have to do is stop that thing, right!」

659:t_015:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Wait, $$竜馬$$! Even you can't do this alone!」

659:t_015:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... Sorry about this. Dragging you along like always.」

659:t_015:5.en:
$$弁慶$$
「We're stuck with each other, like it or not. Don't worry about it.」

659:t_015:6.en:
$$隼人$$
「So... do you have any chance of winning?」

659:t_015:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「How the hell should I know?」

659:t_015:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「All I ever do is fight with everything I've got!」

659:t_016:2.en:
$n
「Isn't there anything you can do, Dr. $$トライア$$!?」

659:t_016:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A $$ゲッター$$ Robo that joins three hearts into one... If it has the power of the $$ゲッター線$$ as well, then perhaps...」

659:t_016:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$ゲッター$$! If you want me to do something for you, then for once, listen to what I say!」

659:t_016:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That dimensional rift...! Lend me the power to blast the Great Void away! For that, I'll hand over my life!」

659:t_017:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's not the usual light of the $$ゲッター線$$!」

659:t_017:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The wills of $$竜馬$$ and $$ゲッター$$ Robo... are becoming... one...」

659:t_018:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The absolute coordinates match the point where we encountered the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s.」

659:t_018:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「It looks like the space of the Great Void has vanished.」

659:t_018:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「Was it the power of $$ゲッター$$...?」

659:t_018:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It doesn't matter now that it's over. Let's think about what comes next instead.」

659:t_019:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「According to the $$クォーター$$, everyone in $c and the Galactic Raid Fleet are somehow safe!」

659:t_019:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「The new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 is still in one piece, too.」

659:t_019:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Now that the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s have vanished along with the dimensional rift, we're going straight to the galactic center in one push.」

659:t_019:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$バアル$$... The time for the decisive battle with the $$宇宙怪獣$$ is coming...」

659:t_020:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「Don't think you can stop us just by throwing numbers at us!」

659:t_021:1.en:
$$カヲル$$
(The fate of those who drowned in power and lost the road to $$シンカ$$... How sad...)

659:t_022:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Get ready, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s! We're not stopping now!」

659:t_023:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「If you are beings who only take lives, then we will fight you to protect them!」

659:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Get ready, boss of the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s! Don't think we'll give up just because there are more of you!」

659:t_100:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You brat! Your arrogance ends here!」

659:t_100:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Nothing can defeat us in this space of the Great Void!」
